facts.fact: 7SUR7.CD reports on 1 October 2026 that ONIP, the Digital Transformation Project unit (UGPTN), the World Bank and AFD discussed drawing up a national civil-registration strategy, a mapping of civil-registry centres and a master plan for their digitisation: all three are still to be written, and no existing plan is named.

A working session reported on 1 October 2026 (the dispatch's date; the meeting's own date is not given) agreed that a small joint team of UGPTN and ONIP would work on civil-registration questions under the Digital Transformation Project, with a digitisation master plan for civil-registry centres among the subjects; AFD raised possible expertise and financing, no sum stated.

systems.owner: not stated; discussed between ONIP, UGPTN, the World Bank and AFD
